audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 1 is linked to the gene PEX7 in curated databases [e_eb525d38a83f].
The Zellweger spectrum disorders are also linked to PEX7, but only by inference from one subtype, with confidence 0.45, and this may not hold for every form [e_ef033d154137].
Zellweger spectrum disorders are linked by curated evidence to PEX1 and PEX10 directly [e_d96688ec4182] [e_f2debbee4e0d].

PEX1, PEX7, PEX10, PEX12, PEX13 and PEX14 all take part in the same curated pathway, peroxisomal protein import [e_8ead7864abed] [e_31fe88a3c275] [e_5a569f5cfe31] [e_8057bc286234] [e_3ca6fdfa23ea] [e_86dcbf9b0503].
Constellate computed that the two disorders look somewhat alike in their listed symptoms, with a score of 0.238 that is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_01e45243e60e].
For Zellweger spectrum disorders, two studies are listed as completed, one drug trial and one survey of symptoms and quality of life [e_a44e194016ef] [e_f81f198b89d9].
For rhizomelic type 1, specks of calcium in infant cartilage and severe poor growth are listed with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_2bf07835a983] [e_8b4757a86e16].
These edges do not show whether the completed drug trial helped anyone [e_a44e194016ef].
